# ReservationTimer

Figma: [08b. ReservationTimer](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-957) · Family: 08 Safqah-Specific · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

A countdown that holds a reservation window for a deal - shows time remaining (days/hours/minutes/seconds) and warns as it runs low. Built from flip-digit Number atoms → Timer units → a Countdown, plus a Small Timer chip, a Collapsed-Reservation banner and a Reservation-Calculater summary. RTL.

Reference image (every variant, labelled): `knowledge/examples/components/reservation-timer/reference.png`

### Numbers

Flip-digit two-digit atom (00 to 59) used inside each Timer unit of the reservation countdown.

Level: atom · Part of: Timer

Use when:
- Digits inside Timer for days, hours, minutes or seconds
- Any flip-digit countdown that needs a value from 00 to 59

Don't use when:
- For a compact MM:SS readout use Small-Numbers
- For amounts use MoneyAmount

Accessibility: Do not announce every tick; the parent timer announces remaining time politely.

### Small Timer

Pill chip with alarm icon, MM:SS and «Deal reservation ends in:» description; Black default, Yellow when low, Green variant.

Level: molecule · Contains: Small-Numbers · Part of: Collapsed-Reservation

Use when:
- Inline reservation time left on a deal card, checkout or sticky footer
- Yellow as the window nears its end

Don't use when:
- For the large multi-unit countdown use Countdown
- For status labels with no time use StatusPill

Accessibility: Keep the readable label and icon; announce remaining time on change at minute granularity.

Compliance: Show only a real reservation window from the server expiry; never fake or reset urgency, and say what happens at 00:00.

### Countdown

Multi-unit countdown (days, hours, minutes) with an optional green label such as «أولوية الاستثمار تنتهي بعد», for a priority or reservation window measured in days.

Level: organism · Contains: Timer

Use when:
- Deal detail showing when an investment priority or reservation window closes
- Windows longer than a few minutes

Don't use when:
- For short MM:SS holds use Small Timer
- For a sticky collapsed bar use Collapsed-Reservation

Accessibility: Use a polite live region; read as «تنتهي بعد يومين و59 ساعة».

Compliance: Show only a real reservation window from the server expiry; never fake or reset urgency, and say what happens at 00:00.

### Collapsed-Reservation

Sticky collapsed reservation bar: headline and description with a Small Timer pill and expand chevron; one tone is brand green, the other orange for urgency, and it can represent several reserved deals.

Level: organism · Contains: Small Timer, Small-Numbers

Use when:
- Keeping an active hold visible while the investor browses
- Has Multi-deals when more than one deal is reserved

Don't use when:
- For inline time only use Small Timer
- For general announcements use Banner

Accessibility: Expand chevron is a button with aria-expanded; announce release at 00:00 with a next step.

Compliance: Show only a real reservation window from the server expiry; never fake or reset urgency, and say what happens at 00:00.

### Reservation-Calculater

Reservation summary: «عائد الاستثمار 12%» expected return amount, investment amount with a «عرض تفاصيل حاسبة الاستثمار» link, and wallet balance row.

Level: organism

Use when:
- Summarising a held reservation before payment
- Linking back to the full calculator details

Don't use when:
- For the full calculator use Investment Calculator
- For payment remaining use Payment-details

Accessibility: The link needs a clear name; read return as expected.

Compliance: Figures are projections: label them expected (متوقع), show net after the agency fee (1% of profit, never of capital) beside gross, and never imply a guaranteed return.

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

ReservationTimer creates urgency: a deal can be held for a limited window, and the timer counts down the remaining time. Use it on a deal card / detail and in a sticky reservation banner. As time runs low the colour shifts (white → yellow → critical) to nudge action.

### Anatomy

Flip-digit Number atoms make up each Timer unit (day / hr / min / sec); units combine into the Countdown. A compact Small Timer chip and the Collapsed-Reservation banner reuse the same numbers.

Countdown

### Number atoms

Numbers is the flip-digit (00–59); Small-Numbers is the compact MM:SS readout, tinted by urgency (White / Green / Yellow).

00

30

59

00:30 White

00:30 Yellow

### Timer units

A unit pairs the digits with a label - Day / hr / min / sec.

Day

hr

min

sec

### Small Timer

Compact chip for inline urgency - Black (default) → Yellow → Green, with optional icon + description.

Black

Yellow

Green

### Reservation states

The Collapsed-Reservation banner (sticky, single or multi-deal) and the Reservation-Calculater summary both surface the live timer.

Collapsed-Reservation

Reservation-Calculater

### Code examples

Flutter - drive from an expiry timestamp.

```dart
ReservationTimer(
  expiresAt: reservation.expiresAt,
  style: TimerStyle.countdown,        // countdown | smallTimer | banner
  tone: remaining < 2.minutes ? Tone.critical
      : remaining < 10.minutes ? Tone.warning : Tone.default,
  onTick: (remaining) => announce(remaining),
  onExpire: () => releaseReservation(),
)
```

### Usage - Do & Don’t

Do

Escalate the colour ramp as time runs out (white → yellow → critical) alongside text.

Don’t

Don’t convey urgency with colour only - keep the readable “X left” label and icon.

Do

Use the collapsed banner to keep the hold visible while the user browses the deal.

Don’t

Don’t freeze silently at 00:00 - say the reservation was released and offer a next step.
